title: Feature flags
subTitle: Feature flags allow you to control the various enabled features in the application

topBanner.title: Banner
topBanner.description: Enable warning banner to be visible

responsesPilot.title: Responses Pilot
responsesPilot.description: Enable new flow for downloading form responses with API key in browser

zitadelLogin.title: Zitadel Login
zitadelLogin.description: Enable Zitadel as a login method for users

notification.title: Notification
notification.description: Enable sending emails immediately or deferred using the Notification flow. Disabling this will send emails directly to GC Notify.

no-flags-set: No flags are set for this user.
userFlagSubHeader: This setting overrides feature flag status, and will provide a specific user access to a feature.
noUserFlags: No user feature flags are set.
